description: Find clinical studies registered on ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, sponsor or intervention, optionally by status (e.g. RECRUITING), phase (1-4), U.S. state or country. Returns status, phase, sponsor, dates, enrolment and the registry link. Pass nct_id for one study. Registry facts only, no advice about joining.

country.description: Country with a study site, e.g. "United States".

nct_id.description: One study by its NCT number, e.g. NCT01234567.

sponsor.description: Sponsor organisation, e.g. a drug company or university.

state.description: U.S. state as a two-letter code (NY) or full name (New York).

name: find_trials
title: Find clinical trials
